name: Hotel Santa Caterina
positioning: Family-run cliffside hotel just outside Amalfi town, with terraces leading down to its own seaside beach club, a member of The Leading Hotels of The World
best_for: Travelers who want an Amalfi base with a beach club and salt water pool at sea level
Couples, families with children and solo travelers

facts.text: The hotel is about 700 meters from the center of Amalfi, in the direction of Positano.
The hotel is built into the cliffside, surrounded by Mediterranean gardens and a series of terraces leading down to beach level.
The hotel offers a free shuttle service to and from the port and center of Amalfi every day of the week.
Guests can book a private boat transfer directly to the hotel's jetty from Naples and other towns along the Amalfi Coast.
Rooms and suites have hand painted majolica floors, marble bathrooms and balconies with sea and garden views.
Glicine restaurant serves modern interpretations of classic Amalfi cuisine.
At the beach club, guests can have a cocktail at the Beach Bar and a Mediterranean style lunch at Al Mare Restaurant.
La Terrazza offers cocktails, bites and snacks throughout the day.
Giusi and Ninni Gambardella, with their children Crescenzo Gargano and Alessandro and Beatrice Camera, directly manage the hotel's day-to-day operations.
The gym has Technogym equipment and windows with views of the sea.
Bath amenities are from Bvlgari's white tea collection.
The hotel is a member of The Leading Hotels of The World.

highlights.text: An elevator descends along the cliff, with a window looking out over the panoramic view.
The Romeo e Giulietta suite is a two-story villa on the cliff above the sea, with a terrace that has a heated infinity pool and solarium.
The beach club has easy access to the sea and a salt water swimming pool, with sun beds, umbrellas, beach towels, and changing and shower areas.
The hotel received its first guests in 1904, after Dr. Giuseppe Gambardella and his family turned their house into a small inn.
Casa Marchesa is a historic residence surrounded by Sfusato Amalfitano lemon groves, with a view of the Mediterranean Sea.

considerations.text: The beach club is open from mid-April to October.
The beach club deck, including the pool, is not fully accessible, but access is possible with the assistance of staff.
WhataHotel notes premium luxury pricing reflecting the exclusive location.
